title: Bound by the maximum of mapped list values
statement: Let $l$ be a list of natural numbers, let $f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and let $a\in l$. Then $f(a)$ is at most the maximum of the values of $f$ on the entries of $l$, with the maximum taken together with $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a list of natural numbers
